high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "madewithspin." The post is sponsored and includes a call to action to "Expand story," suggesting that there is more content available if the viewer clicks on it. The main focus of the image is a display of eco-collectibles. These collectibles appear to be wooden bird sculptures arranged on a white pedestal. The birds are intricately designed with a minimalist aesthetic, featuring clean lines and a natural wood finish.
